description: Rest spaces and gate structures placed from the SCNU 360 VR tour (visual reference only, nothing copied) and checked against the NGII 2025 orthophoto; read by stages/furniture.mjs after objects-campus.geojson. Every position and dimension is an estimate (estimated: true).

properties.note: 국립순천대학교 / SCNU letter sign on a planted stone bed at the road edge of the A19 gate plaza. From the scene_a19 camera over the gate crossing (about 244182, 263716, 11.7 m from the car scale on the d face) the letters span l cols 693-981 (bearings 176-192 deg) and their base sits about 21 deg below the horizon, and the slab subtends about 16 deg: about 25 m south of the camera, just inside the plaza edge wall OC0128. Lettering not modelled (plain white slab and name band). Supersedes the survey point OC0111 (left out).
